title: Discover Downtown Phoenix's Best Craft Beer & Hidden Gems
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Downtown Phoenix Walking Brew Tour offers guests the ultimate small group craft beer experience—on foot! Covering approximately two-thirds of a mile, this guided tour takes you through the heart of Roosevelt Row, where you’ll visit a mix of iconic taprooms and exciting new breweries that are redefining the Phoenix beer scene. Along the way, you’ll enjoy expertly curated beer tastings, insider stories, and plenty of local flavor—all within a fun, easy walking route perfect for groups, date nights, or beer-loving friends.

-Exclusive access to 3 Downtown Phoenix breweries. Skip the lines and maximize the fun.

-Expert guide keeps the energy high with stories, tips, and laughs

-Up to 12 tastings plus a gourmet snack to complement your craft beer journey

-Fun, social, and interactive — a walking adventure full of surprises and flavors
